text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is about to get underway!
All eyes are naturally on the 'Empress' Air Groove, and the 'Otherworldly Fugitive' Silence Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The venue is already engulfed in
incredible heat and excitement!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure Suzuka will break away from the front and leave everyone in the dust today too!"

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I saw how she ran in the Sapporo Kinen!
I know Air Groove's gonna pull it off!"
While seeing Air Groove off—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...We've finally come this far.
choice_data_list: Now just run it out to the finish.
Now just run it out to the finish, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
All that's left is to do our very best.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Relief?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because the strong Air Groove aura returned.
The usual one, the one I know so well—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The you right now...
might be an Air Groove I've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What on earth could that be...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Even faster, even sharper than when we ran last time... it feels like she's about to overtake me—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can feel it... that this is the strongest Air Groove yet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"When I ran in the Takarazuka Kinen...
it felt so, so good to run."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
With the current Air Groove, I feel like I could definitely...
run even faster than back then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gladly, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're faster than you were at the Takarazuka Kinen—
and today, I will definitely beat you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be going on ahead.
Let's both do our best."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Do not worry. I will fear no longer."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—Have faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am the "Empress." A "challenger" who guides all Umamusume, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is your "ideal."
